T: Through the wardrobe. Mind the Turkish delight.
D: Four children step through a wardrobe into Narnia and join Aslan against the White Witch.
P: Serve dessert when the White Witch offers Edmund the Turkish delight.
S: Buttered toast fingers with mashed sardine and lemon, or honey
Toast fingers buttered and topped with sardines and lemon, or with honey, served with a pot of tea.
Light scones made with cream and lemonade, served warm
Scones of self-raising flour, cream and lemonade, baked at 220C for 15 minutes, with jam and cream.
M: Flathead fried in butter, parsley butter potatoes, buttered peas
Fish fillets pan-fried in butter until golden, served with boiled potatoes and peas tossed in parsley butter and lemon.

Roast lamb with rosemary and garlic, roast potatoes and carrots, served for the whole army. Make small slits in a 2kg lamb leg and push in garlic slivers and rosemary sprigs. Rub with olive oil, salt and pepper. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes, adding 1kg potatoes and 4 carrots in chunks tossed in oil for the last hour. Rest the lamb 15 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, whisk in 300ml stock and bubble into gravy. Carve and serve on a big platter with the veg and mint sauce.
W: Chewy rosewater candy, pink and set firm
Rosewater jelly of sugar, cornflour and lemon cooked for an hour until thick, set overnight, cut into cubes and rolled in icing sugar.
K: Milk whisked with dark chocolate and cinnamon, topped with whipped cream
Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with cinnamon, topped with whipped cream.

flavour.sign: Tea and Toast by the Fire

note.text: Come in out of the snow, Lucy. There's tea, toast, sardines and cake, and a story or two.

winks: The lamp-post glowing in the snow
The wardrobe full of fur coats

steps.text: Toast the bread and butter it while hot.
Mash the sardines with a squeeze of lemon and spread on half the toast.
Drizzle honey over the rest.
Cut into fingers and serve with a pot of tea.
Toast the bread and butter it while hot.
Mash the beans with the olive oil, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper and spread on half the toast.
Drizzle honey over the rest.
Cut into fingers and serve with a pot of tea.
Heat the oven to 220C and flour a tray.
Mix the flour, cream and lemonade with a knife until just combined.
Pat out the dough, cut into rounds and place them close together on the tray.
Bake until risen and golden.
Serve warm with jam and whipped cream.
Peel and cut the potatoes, chop the parsley and pat the fish dry.
Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and toss with some of the butter and the parsley.
Pan-fry the fish in butter until golden on both sides.
Cook the peas, then toss with butter and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve everything together.
Peel and cut the potatoes, chop the parsley and pat the haloumi dry.
Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, drain and toss with some of the butter, the parsley and pepper.
Dust the haloumi in the flour and pan-fry in butter until golden on both sides.
Cook the peas, then toss with butter and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve everything together.

ingredients.item: pink food colouring, a few drops

steps.text: Line a tin with baking paper. Juice the lemon.
Stir the sugar, cornflour, water and lemon juice in a pot over low heat for an hour until very thick.
Stir in the rosewater and a few drops of pink colouring, then pour into the tin.
Leave to set overnight.
Cut into cubes and roll in icing sugar.
Chop the chocolate and whip the cream to soft peaks.
Heat the milk until steaming.
Whisk in the chocolate and cinnamon until frothy.
Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream.

s.note: Buttered toast fingers with mashed sardine and lemon, or honey
s.how: Toast white bread and butter it while hot. Top half with mashed sardines and a squeeze of lemon. Drizzle the rest with honey. Cut into fingers and serve with a pot of tea, as a faun would to a lost girl.

s.note: Light scones made with cream and lemonade, served warm
s.how: Mix 450g self-raising flour with 300ml cream and 300ml lemonade until just combined. Pat out, cut into rounds and bake close together at 220C for 15 minutes. Serve warm with strawberry jam and whipped cream in a big old house.

m.note: Flathead fried in butter, parsley butter potatoes, buttered peas
m.how: Pan-fry 4 flathead fillets in butter until golden. Boil 800g potatoes and toss with parsley butter. Cook peas and toss with butter and a squeeze of lemon. Serve together at a cosy table in a beaver dam.

w.note: Chewy rosewater candy, pink and set firm
w.how: Boil 500g sugar, 120g cornflour and 750ml water with the juice of a lemon, stirring, over low heat for an hour until very thick. Stir in rosewater and pink colouring, pour into a lined tin and set overnight. Cut into cubes and roll in icing sugar.

d.note: Milk whisked with dark chocolate and cinnamon, topped with whipped cream
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate and a pinch of cinnamon until frothy. Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream. A gift for anyone who has spent too long in an endless winter.
